title: Erika Siemsen
description: Supported the termination of all contracts with the Milwaukee Police department for the services of School Resource Officers and other personnel.
body:
# Erika Siemsen

# Board Director

![](/media/uploads/2026/07/erika-siemens.webp)

Supported [the termination](https://restoration-news.com/getmedia/1348b1d5-27b8-4392-8788-f4547f576d88/Milwaukee-Herndon-SRO-meeting-minutes.pdf) of all contracts with the Milwaukee Police department for the services of School Resource Officers and other personnel.
